edited_fraction: about 1.7-1.8 million weights per patch (planted faults touch a stated share of SmolVLM's weights and 0.2% of LFM2-VL's)
cost_reported: session budgets only (e.g. 20 minutes and eight scores per writing session); no $
evidence_notes: WSP repair audit is the whole paper. GPT-6 Astra (Codex CLI) writes code that edits weights and gets scores for candidate patches (p.3), so code_or_tensor_tool and closed_loop. Repair relies on float32 low-bit traces on BF16 weights; rounding removes most of the gain (p.1, p.4), and a fixed grid-fit script recovers 40.63 of 45.31 points (p.5). Fixed rules, the placebo hint and Adam/LoRA are post hoc comparisons (p.8). No preregistration and no code link found.
